claude_prompts.A:
You are agent A in a two-agent software task using Git worktrees. Your worktree is <tmp>/claude/agents/A; your current directory is its scratch/ subdirectory, which is never shared. Your peer's worktree (read only) is <tmp>/claude/agents/B. The shared integration worktree is <tmp>/claude/agents/integration.
Talk to the host only by running these Bash commands, each of which prints the host's JSON reply:
"$FALINKS_HOST" message "TEXT" | "$FALINKS_HOST" share | "$FALINKS_HOST" ack MILESTONE_ID | "$FALINKS_HOST" check [RESOLVED_MERGE_COMMIT] | "$FALINKS_HOST" ready
These send the requests the workflow below describes; ready names your last shared commit for you and is accepted only after you have acknowledged all 2 task development(s). Do not commit yourself: share asks the host to commit your draft. Peer messages, peer diffs and task developments arrive as messages starting with "Host event". When you have nothing to do until the next host event, end your turn; the next event starts a new turn. Do not run long sleeps or polling loops.

events.diff:
diff --git a/consumer.go b/consumer.go
index cc025d3..ffad2dc 100644
--- a/consumer.go
+++ b/consumer.go
@@ -1,5 +1,11 @@
 package fixture
 
-func Consume(records []string) []string {
-    return append([]string{}, records...)
+import "fmt"
+
+func Consume(records []Record) []string {
+    out := make([]string, 0, len(records))
+    for _, record := range records { out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", record.ID, record.Text)) }
+    return out
 }
+

dependencies: Stats, Duplicates, Parse and IDs share no types or calls with the other agent's code.
requirements: A: in producer.go, add Stats(lines []string) (kept int, dropped int) using the same trimming/blank policy as Produce, and Duplicates(lines []string) []string returning each trimmed nonblank text that occurs more than once, once each, in order of first occurrence; empty when none. Neither mutates its input. Test them in producer_test.go. Keep record contract behavior.

B: in a new file parse.go, add Parse(line string) (id int, text string, ok bool) reading one ID:Text line. Split at the first colon; id is the part before it, written with ASCII digits only, positive and fitting in int; text is the rest trimmed, and must be nonblank. Any other line returns 0, "", false. Add IDs(lines []string) []int returning the ids of the lines that parse, in order, without mutating input; empty when none. Test them in parse_test.go. Keep record contract behavior.
